title: MZ Revenir: A Short Horror RPG

posts.author: GoodSelf
posts.body:
GOOD SELF GAMES PRESENTS
A former cultist returns to their hometown to finish what they started, but fate has different plans for them.
Revenir
is a jam game designed in RPG Maker MZ. This is top-down 2D exploration RPG that tasks you with investigating the doomed town of Revenir. Talk to the cultist villagers, complete quests, battle against strange beasts,  unlock forgotten memories, and finally face the truth behind why you returned. The game should take around an hour to complete, give or take 20 minutes depending on your experience with RPG Maker games.
The following (2) plugins were created with assistance from AI tools:
FFA_SeparateFaceWindow.js
FFA_DragTilemapMaskPersistFix.js
Spoiler
Spoiler
This game was designed as an entry for the 1st ever Toasty Time RPG Maker Game Jam.
The theme of this jam was Unnerving and Uncomfortable and we had only 9 days to finish our game.
Aside from following the Itch.io terms of service and using an RPG Maker engine or similar, there were no other stipulations to this challenge.
You can learn more about this jam and the creators who participated by clicking the userbar at the top of this section.

Spoiler
This game uses screen effects and transition effect plugins which have been confirmed to cause slowdown on certain PCs
Autosave does not function and is turned off
Message offset "breaks" and the "culprit" has not been found. Messages might appear more offset than usual
When  leaving a building/entering a building, you may be moved in the opposite or wrong direction. Simply use the door again to fix. NOTE: If your game crashes after this, please kindly restart to your last save and inform me of where the crash occurred, please and thank you (your game can be saved at a monolith)
